clips.summary: Horizontal center-crop from 1280x720 to 576x720 (4:5 aspect ratio) cuts off the burned-in top header labels, the house on the left, the left side of the turnip, and the characters entering on the right later in the video.

findings.observation: Horizontal cropping to 576x720 removes the left and right burned-in header text ('Репка' and 'STORY-TALES') inside the top banner, truncates the turnip on the left edge, and removes the house.
As more characters join the line on the right, the narrow 576px width cuts off the dog and completely omits the cat and mouse that are visible in the source video.

suggestions.reason: Preserve the original 1280x720 horizontal span so the wide character lineup, turnip, and top header labels are not cut off.

limitations: No audio streams exist in source or clip-A.
